title: Kieran Culkin Thinks a Succession Spinoff Would Be a Terrible Idea
excerpt:
The Roman Roy actor is skeptical about revisiting the acclaimed HBO drama.
He also revealed plans to reunite with creator Jesse Armstrong on a film.
body_md:
Kieran Culkin has dismissed the idea of a Succession spinoff during an appearance on Heart Breakfast. When a host said she was still mourning the series, he joked that viewers had already had three years to move on.

Asked whether the story could continue through a separate series, Culkin called that a terrible idea and jokingly suggested a sitcom centered on Cousin Greg as an example of what audiences might be asking for. His comments reflect his own opinion, not an official HBO announcement.

He nevertheless admitted that he misses playing Roman Roy and working with the cast. According to Culkin, creator Jesse Armstrong considered several possible fifth-season directions while developing the final season, and some of those ideas sounded appealing.

Ultimately, Culkin believes the fourth season brought the story to the right conclusion. He also disclosed plans to work with Armstrong again on a new movie.

The actor is currently appearing as a younger Caesar Flickerman in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. His comments underline the distinction between affection for a finished series and enthusiasm for extending it.
